_doc: 1.5.0 (N-M4CALL, 2026-08-01) — ONE change: 77, 88 and 99 are carved out of
the `vs_4bet` `22-99` push/fold mix into their own mix with a CALL leg,
{call 0.30, 5bet_shove 0.40, fold 0.30}. 22-66 keep {5bet_shove 0.40,
fold 0.60} byte-identical, and no other class, node or lever moves.
WHY (theory finding T-M4, the follow-up 1.4.0 filed below and did not
settle): 1.4.0 shipped ALL of 22-99 as jam-or-fold under a 'no set-mining
price' rationale that its own review already narrowed to 22-66 — TT and up
have call legs at the same depths, so the pair row was inconsistent, not
principled. The honest test for 77-99 is the DIRECT price (theory contract
§3 T3, pure-call break-even E >= B/(P+B)), priced on the LEVER-DERIVED
canonical single-raised chain — open 2.5, maniac 3-bets 3.3x, opener
4-bets 3.0x, all from this pack's own `sizing` block — which leaves a
call of 13.86 into a pot of 35.16 (post-call SPR 1.56):
That is a REFERENCE GEOMETRY, not a measurement of the live node: the
arrival probe counts channels and does not price them, and re-pricing
its replayed decisions gives a mean call of 28.6 into 73.7 with a median
post-call SPR of 0.562 over 150 OOP / 132 IP arrivals. The live node is
a mixture; this mix is authored against the canonical chain and the
difference is recorded rather than smoothed over.
Measured with the repo's own `equity_vs_range` (20k iters, seed 7, hero
against a value-only 4-bet range (QQ+, AK) and 0.3782 / 0.3760 / 0.3772
against a wider one, +- ~0.002 of suit-choice noise (an independent
re-run at the same seed with other combos read 0.3612 / 0.3550 / 0.3604).
ROBUSTNESS, as the MASS-WEIGHTED claim it actually is: the price is NOT
cleared against every 4-bettor at this table. The nit 4-bets {AA 0.5, KK
0.3, QQ 0.1} and the fish {AA 0.5}, and against those 77-99 hold ~0.19 —
missing the 0.2827 price by ~9pts. That tight tail is ~0.6% of the
roster's combined 4-bet mass against the maniac's own 34.7%, and against
the roster-POOLED 4-bet range 77/99 read 0.52 / 0.56. So the tail exists,
is named, and does not govern: a class-level mix answers the mixture the
maniac actually faces, which is overwhelmingly wide. Folding 0.60 of
these three was leaving a priced-in call on the floor.
WHY ONLY 0.30 OF IT, not the whole fold — a DIRECTIONAL, UNMEASURED
premise rather than settled law: T3 prices RAW equity, and an underpair
realizes below raw at these depths (it flops a set 11.8% of the time and
otherwise plays a bluff-catcher with little implied odds left to win;
arrivals are mixed IP/OOP, 132 of 282 in position). The size of that
discount is not measured here, so the minority call leg is the shape the
premise implies, not a proven optimum — a future re-fit that measures
realization may refute it.
WHY THE JAM STAYS AT 0.40 (level unchanged — this slice adds a leg, it
does not re-level), with the stacks done EXACTLY: after 3-betting to 9.9
the maniac has 90.1 behind and the 4-bettor has only 76.24 behind, so
THE VILLAIN CANNOT COVER THE JAM — and §3's T1/T2 forms silently assume
villain covers B. Taking the break-even off the real final pot instead:
which is ABOVE these hands' ~0.36, so the shove is not a value commit and
needs fold equity (the conclusion holds a fortiori against the naive
covered-B reading of 0.419). By T2 the required realized fold equity is
uncovered-B caveat makes any T2 number here an approximation). Live for
this archetype against a range that 4-bet a 21%-of-hands 3-bet range, but
not free. 0.40 is also the only level that keeps both pair ladders
intact: it must be >= 66's 0.40 (jam mass non-decreasing up the row) and
<= TT's 0.45 (the T-L1 99->TT inversion tripwire).
The fold 0.30 is the residual, and the arrival-weighted aggregate moves
nearer the dossier row on both legs that moved, inside every asserted
bound, and the `*` tail-mass tripwire is untouched (no class changed
tier).
1.4.0 (N-M4BET, 2026-07-31) — the `vs_4bet` node REPLACED (one change;
nothing else in the pack is touched).
THE DEFECT (theory finding T-R2): the node covered 18 of the 169 hand
classes, and `sample_preflop_action` folds an uncovered class 1.0 with no
fall-through — so weighted by the range the maniac actually ARRIVES with
(its own vs_rfi 3-bet mass, 284.4 combos = 21.45% of hands) the node
answered a 4-bet fold 0.814 / call 0.041 / jam 0.145. 73.6% of arriving
mass (AQo, KQo, KJo, QJo, JTo, ATo, AJo, A9o, AJs, 44-22 and the whole
light-3-bet tail) was an INVISIBLE fold. The 1.3.0 fix (99/88/77) was the
one hole a contiguity lint could see; the offsuit coverage gap was the
disease.
SCOPE OF THAT MEASUREMENT (review fold, 3-way convergent): the arrival
model above is CONDITIONAL, not the whole node. `_preflop_facing` labels
vs_4bet on raise-count n>=3, and the node is history-blind, so production
also routes here: the opener facing a cold 4-bet, the ISO-raiser over
limpers whose raise started the chain, a cold caller, and n>=4 re-entrant
arrivals (where `5bet_shove` is a misnomer and, facing an all-in, degrades
to a call via play.py's legality fallback). Seeded production-sizing probe,
4000 hands: 70.2% of the maniac's vs_4bet decisions are n=3, and 45.9% are
the modeled fresh-3-bettor channel (the iso-raiser channel is 3.2% — real,
traced, and not modeled). The fit below is therefore a fit of the DOMINANT
channel, not of the node's whole traffic.
THE FIT: every class the maniac 3-bets now hits an explicit mix, and the
arrival-weighted aggregate is fold 0.286 / call 0.336 / jam 0.378 against
the dossier's online row 25/35/40 (playstyle-research/maniac.md, `Facing
a 4-bet after 3-betting` — an author-asserted calibration band, UNVERIFIED,
so it is gated only as one-sided red-first bounds (fold < 0.40, call >
0.15, jam > 0.25) with the +-0.05 comparison PRINTED, not asserted).
WHY SO LITTLE FOLDING: a ~25-30% fold aggregate over a 21%-of-hands 3-bet
range is the archetype, not a slip — this bot 3-bets junk and then
refuses to be pushed off it. The fold budget is spent where it reads
true: the any-two light-3-bet tail (11.8% of arriving mass) folds 0.65,
small/middle pairs fold 0.60, weak offsuit aces 0.45, and the tiers above
them mostly continue.
COMPOSITION LAWS the tiers keep:
⚠️ LAW (1) BELOW IS SUPERSEDED FOR 77-99 BY 1.5.0 ABOVE — those three now
carry a call leg, so it holds only for 22-66, which is exactly the
narrowing its own closing paragraph describes and filed.
(1) Pairs 22-99 are JAM-OR-FOLD at the wave-3 level {jam 0.40, fold 0.60}
— unchanged by this slice, which briefly raised the level and was refuted:
the aggregate sits inside every bound with the wave-3 weights, so nothing
in the fit justified moving them. The no-set-mining rationale is narrowed
to 22-66; for 77-99 the honest test is the DIRECT price — at SPR ~1.5 a
call of ~14 into ~35.5 needs ~28% equity, which 77-99 clear — so whether
77-99 deserve a call leg is an OPEN question FILED as a follow-up, not
settled here. This pass authors no new call legs.
(2) Wheel aces A5s-A2s stay a jam-or-fold blocker block and jam strictly
more (0.7) than the middle suited aces (0.3) — the polar construction
RR-LINT used to record as an As-row coverage gap, now expressed in
weights and pinned by test_nm4bet_..._suited_ace_construction_is_pinned.
(3) Air (the `*` tier) prefers the RE-BLUFF to the call: jam 0.20 > call
0.15 — a hand with no showdown value does not call a 4-bet out of
position, it shoves or it goes away.
(4) The mixes (11 at 1.4.0, 12 at 1.5.0) are in AUTHORED PRIORITY order (first-match-wins), which
is NOT monotone in continue mass — two inversions are deliberate:
(a) SMALL-PAIR NO-CALL — 22-99 continue 0.40, BELOW junkier tiers like
K5s at 0.75, because pairs here are pure jam-or-fold while the suited /
broadway tiers have a call leg to spend continue mass on.
[1.5.0: now reads 22-66 continue 0.40; 77-99 continue 0.70, still below
the K5s tier's 0.75, so the inversion survives on both blocks. The
interleaving lint also stays clean: the new mix's dominant non-fold
action is still `5bet_shove` at 0.40, level with 22-66's.]
(b) DOMINATED-ACE POLARITY — A8o-A2o continue 0.55, below the weaker-
looking KTo/98o tier at 0.65, and A5s-A2s jam 0.70 above the stronger
ATs-A6s tier's 0.30: hands whose value is card removal against an
ace-heavy 4-betting range are played polar (jam the blocker or fold),
not flatted into a dominated pot.
Dominant NON-FOLD weights still only descend down the list, so RR-LINT's
weight-interleaving lint stays clean apart from the frozen AA/KK -> QQ
entry (AA/KK trap at 0.3 while QQ/AK, which want no showdown, jam 1.0).
